info.title: SutraERP API
info.description:
SutraERP education ERP — synchronous REST/JSON API (major version v1).

Conventions (ADR-L5-0034): camelCase JSON members; URL major versioning (`/api/v1`); RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` errors with `errorCode`, `correlationId` and `validationErrors` extensions; retry-sensitive commands accept `Idempotency-Key`.

Authentication (ADR-L5-0024/0038): dev mode signs in with `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (+ TOTP `POST /api/v1/auth/mfa/verify`); Keycloak mode with the OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE flow `GET /api/v1/auth/oidc/start` → `/oidc/callback`. Both set an opaque `HttpOnly` session cookie; the session's `csrfToken` must be sent as `X-CSRF-Token` on every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE made with the cookie. Login and MFA verification instead need the signed double-submit token from `GET /api/v1/auth/csrf`. Unsafe requests from another site (`Origin` / `Sec-Fetch-Site`) are rejected. Tenant/institution scope is taken from the session (ADR-L5-0004); scope headers cannot select or widen it. Admin-sensitive permissions need an MFA-verified session (`mfa-step-up-required`). Missing session: 401; CSRF failure, cross-site request, missing permission or step-up: 403 (`application/problem+json`).

get.description:
Sets the `__Host-sutra_login_csrf` cookie and returns the same signed value; `POST /login`
and `POST /mfa/verify` must echo it in `X-CSRF-Token` (signed double submit).

post.summary: Authenticate with login id + password (dev mode).
post.description:
Requires the pre-session CSRF token (`GET /api/v1/auth/csrf`) in `X-CSRF-Token`. On success
sets an opaque `HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict` session cookie and returns the session's
CSRF token. Principals that need MFA and have an enrolled TOTP factor get `mfaRequired` and
must call `/api/v1/auth/mfa/verify`; those without a factor get a single-factor session with
`mfaEnrollmentRequired = true`. Any presented session is revoked and replaced (fixation
defence). In Keycloak mode this endpoint answers `501` (no ROPC; use OIDC).

403.description: Login CSRF token missing/invalid or cross-site request

post.summary: End the current session (idempotent).
post.description:
With a live session the request must carry `X-CSRF-Token` (prevents forced sign-out). For a
Keycloak session the response is `200` with the IdP's RP-initiated logout URL.

200.description: Signed out; continue at the IdP to end the SSO session

get.summary: Second-factor status of the signed-in account.

post.summary: Step up the current session with a TOTP code (needed for admin-sensitive permissions).
post.description:
The session is rotated (new cookie and CSRF token) to `mfaLevel = mfa`; its absolute expiry
is unchanged. In Keycloak mode use `GET /api/v1/auth/oidc/start?stepUp=true` instead.

401.description: No session, wrong or replayed code

delete.summary: Turn off the authenticator app (needs an MFA-verified session).
delete.description: Refused (`409`) when it is the last second factor of an account whose role requires MFA.

409.description: Last factor of an account that requires MFA

post.summary: Confirm TOTP enrolment with the first code; activates the factor and upgrades the session.
post.description: The session is rotated (new cookie and CSRF token) to `mfaLevel = mfa`.

post.summary: Start TOTP enrolment for the signed-in account (dev mode).
post.description:
Returns a fresh secret as an `otpauth://` URI; nothing changes until `…/totp/confirm`
accepts a code from it. Replacing an already active factor requires an MFA-verified session.

post.summary: Complete a TOTP challenge issued by `login`.
post.description:
Requires the same pre-session CSRF token the challenge was issued to. A challenge is single
use (a wrong code burns it) and expires after 5 minutes; each TOTP time step is accepted once.

401.description: Unknown/expired challenge, wrong or replayed code

post.summary: Begin a passkey assertion to step up the current session.
Start the passkey option of a sign-in challenge.
post.description:
Consumes `challengeId` and returns a **new** one (carrying the WebAuthn ceremony) together
with the assertion options for `navigator.credentials.get`. The new id also still accepts a
TOTP code at `/api/v1/auth/mfa/verify`. Requires the pre-session CSRF token the challenge
was issued to.

delete.summary:
Remove one of the caller's passkeys (needs an MFA-verified session). Removing the last
second factor of an account whose role requires MFA is refused (`409`).

409.description: Last factor of an account that requires MFA

post.summary: Begin registering a passkey for the signed-in account.
post.description:
Returns the creation options for `navigator.credentials.create` and a `ceremonyId`.
Adding a passkey to an account that already has a second factor needs an MFA-verified
session (`403 mfa-step-up-required`).

post.summary: Finish passkey registration; the session is rotated to `mfaLevel = mfa`.
Finish a passkey step-up; the session is rotated to `mfaLevel = mfa` (absolute expiry kept).
Finish a sign-in challenge with a passkey.
post.description:
Single use like the TOTP path: a failed assertion burns the challenge. On success the
session is created with `mfaLevel = mfa` (`amr` = `pwd`, `hwk`, `mfa`).

401.description: Unknown challenge, wrong browser, or assertion rejected

post.summary: OIDC Back-Channel Logout 1.0 receiver (Keycloak → SutraERP, server to server).
post.description:
Body: `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` with `logout_token`. The token is validated
(JWKS signature, `iss`, `aud`, `iat`/`exp`, back-channel-logout `events`, `sid`/`sub`, no
`nonce`), its `jti` must not have been seen before, and then every SutraERP session bound
to the IdP session `sid` (or, without `sid`, every federated session of `sub`) is revoked.
Answers `200` (also when no session matched) or `400`; never sets cookies.

200.description: Logout token accepted; matching sessions revoked

400.description: Missing, invalid or replayed logout token

get.description:
Consumes the single-use `state`, checks the browser-binding cookie, exchanges the code with
the PKCE verifier, validates the ID token (JWKS signature, `iss`, `aud`, `exp`, `nonce`),
maps roles and tenant claims, creates the session and redirects (`303`) into the SPA. Any
failure redirects to `/sign-in?authError=<code>` without a session.

get.summary: Start an OIDC sign-in at Keycloak (Authorization Code + PKCE, Keycloak mode).
get.description:
Stores `state`, `nonce` and the PKCE verifier server-side for 10 minutes, binds the request
to this browser with a `SameSite=Lax` cookie and redirects (`303`) to Keycloak.

parameters.name: returnTo
parameters.description: SPA path to land on after sign-in (relative, same origin). Defaults to `/`.

303.description: Redirect to the Keycloak authorization endpoint

get.summary: Current session: principal, expiries, assurance and the session's CSRF token.
get.description: Counts as activity (slides the idle window; the write is throttled).

get.summary: Active sessions of the signed-in account (newest first; the current one is flagged).

post.summary: Sign out every other session of this account ("sign out other devices").

delete.summary: Sign out one other session of this account. The current session ends with `POST /logout`.

404.description: Not a live session of this account

409.description: That is the current session (use logout)

post.summary: Register an institution (reference aggregate) in the caller's session tenant.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Required. Session CSRF token from login or GET /api/v1/auth/session.

get.summary: Get an institution of the caller's session tenant (`institution.read`).
get.description: Institutions of other tenants are indistinguishable from missing ones (404).

patch.summary: Rename an institution of the caller's session tenant (optimistic concurrency via `If-Match`).

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag of the version being modified

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Required. Session CSRF token from login or GET /api/v1/auth/session.

get.summary: Notices: the caller's live notices (pinned first), or every notice (`view=manage`).

post.summary: Publish a notice (`notice.manage`; `Idempotency-Key` required).

get.summary: One notice. Readers only see live notices addressed to one of their roles (otherwise 404).

patch.summary: Update a notice (`notice.manage`, `If-Match` required). Archived notices cannot change.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag of the version being modified

post.summary: Archive a notice (`notice.manage`; idempotent). It disappears for readers immediately.

get.summary: The caller's notifications, newest first (cursor pagination).

post.summary: Mark every visible notification read.

get.summary: Number of unread notifications (the bell badge).

post.summary: Mark one notification read (idempotent). Notifications not addressed to the caller → 404.

get.summary: Modules composed into this modular-monolith build.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Only workspaces visible to this role.

get.summary: The caller's profile (created from the session's principal on first access).

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag of the profile version being modified

post.summary: Create a to-do for yourself, or assign one (`todo.assign`; `Idempotency-Key` required).
Mark one of your to-dos done.
Dismiss one of your to-dos (no longer relevant).
Reopen a completed or dismissed to-do.

inApp.description: Show in the in-app inbox (security notifications cannot be muted).

critical.description:
A failing critical check makes the instance unready (503); a failing non-critical check
(advisory cache, event broker behind the outbox) only reports `degraded`.

csrfToken.description:
Pre-session CSRF token; echo it as `X-CSRF-Token` on login and MFA verification. The
same value is set in the `__Host-sutra_login_csrf` cookie (double submit).

ExecutionScope.description:
The validated scope a protected operation executes in. Must be carried across every
synchronous, asynchronous, workflow and persistence hand-off.

FactorAuthority.description: Who manages the account's second factors.

FieldViolation.description: A single field-level validation failure (`validationErrors[]` in problem+json).

field.description: JSON pointer or dotted path of the offending member.

status.description: `ok`, `degraded` (some check failed; 503 only if a critical one did) or `draining`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone governing business-local dates for this institution.

InstitutionId.description: Institution scope, always a descendant of a Tenant.

loginId.description: Governed login identifier (e-mail in the dev realm).

csrfToken.description:
Present when `outcome = authenticated`: the session's synchronizer CSRF token. Send it as
`X-CSRF-Token` on every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE made with the session cookie.

expiresAt.description: Present when `outcome = authenticated`: absolute session expiry.

mfaEnrollmentRequired.description:
`true` when the account must enrol a second factor (`/api/v1/auth/mfa/totp/enrolment`);
until then step-up-protected permissions are refused.

oneOf.description: Present when `outcome = authenticated`: assurance of the new session.

endSessionUrl.description: Keycloak RP-initiated logout URL; navigate the browser there to end the SSO session.

MfaLevel.description:
Authentication assurance of a session (ADR-L5-0038 §3.8).

`Mfa` means the session was established (or stepped up) with a second factor: a TOTP code
verified by SutraERP in dev mode, or Keycloak-asserted `amr`/`acr` values in Keycloak mode.

MfaMethod.description: MFA method family (WebAuthn preferred for privileged users, TOTP fallback).

mfaRequired.description: The account's role requires a second factor.

webauthnAvailable.description: Dev-mode WebAuthn is available in this deployment.

batch.description: Delivery batch that implements the module.

audienceRoles.description: Roles that see the notice (at least one).

assigneeLoginId.description: Assign to this person (login id of someone who has signed in before); omitted = me.

readAt.description: When the caller read it; `null` = unread.

NotificationCategory.description: What a notification is about (also the unit of notification preferences).

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next (older) page; absent on the last page.

PasskeyInfo.description: A registered passkey / security key (public data only).

Principal.description: The authenticated principal (technical identity bound to a SutraERP canonical identity).

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem document with SutraERP extension members.

correlationId.description: SutraERP extension: request correlation id (technical context only).

errorCode.description: SutraERP extension: stable machine-readable error code.

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type.

code.description: Short institution code, unique within the tenant (`A-Z0-9-`, 2–32 chars).

Role.description:
Application role as presented by the web client. Authorization decisions use the
[`Permission`] map below, never the role name directly.

csrfToken.description: Synchronizer CSRF token bound to this session; send as `X-CSRF-Token` on unsafe requests.

idleExpiresAt.description: Expiry if the session stays idle from now on (sliding window).

mfaEnrollmentRequired.description: `true` when the account must enrol a second factor.

mfaLevel.description: Assurance of the session: `mfa` once a second factor was verified.

assignedBy.description: Subject that assigned it (`null` = created by the system or by the assignee).

link.description: Application path where the work happens.

openCount.description: Open items of the caller (all pages).

code.description: Six-digit TOTP code from the authenticator app.

otpauthUri.description: `otpauth://totp/…` key URI (render as a QR code).

secret.description: Base32 shared secret for manual entry.

UpdateNotice.description: Partial update; omitted members are unchanged. `clearExpiry: true` removes the expiry.

UpdateProfile.description:
Partial update; omitted members are unchanged. An empty `contactEmail` / `contactPhone`
clears it.

WebauthnCeremony.description:
A WebAuthn ceremony handed to the browser: `options` is the JSON form of
`PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions` / `…RequestOptions` (binary members base64url encoded,
under `publicKey`); `ceremony_id` names the server-side state (single use, short lived).

WebauthnChallengeRequest.description: Pre-session request naming the sign-in challenge.

WebauthnChallengeResponse.description:
Sign-in challenge after the passkey option was started: use the **new** `challengeId` for
both `…/webauthn/verify` and the TOTP `…/mfa/verify` (the previous one was consumed).

label.description: Name shown in the security page (defaults to "Passkey").

csrf_token.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrf_token.description: Session-bound synchronizer token from login or GET /api/v1/auth/session.

login_csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
login_csrf.description: Pre-session double-submit token from GET /api/v1/auth/csrf (must equal the `__Host-sutra_login_csrf` cookie).

session_cookie.name: __Host-sutra_session
session_cookie.description: Opaque server-side session token (`sutra_session` when Secure cookies are off in dev).
